days.label: Day 1

slots.label: Breakfast / iconic coffee
slots.purpose: Introduce local food culture through breakfast or a distinctive cafe.

slots.label: Market / food exploration
slots.purpose: Browse a market and learn about ingredients; avoid another full meal.

slots.label: Signature lunch
slots.purpose: Anchor lunch around a regional specialty.

slots.label: Neighborhood walk / light activity
slots.purpose: Create a non-food breathing space between meals.

slots.label: Specialty tasting / snack
slots.purpose: Try one specialty in a small portion, not another full meal.

slots.label: Destination dinner
slots.purpose: Make dinner a deliberate culinary destination.

slots.label: Dessert / drinks
slots.purpose: Offer an optional small finish suited to appetite and energy.
